approvalEvidence.scopeInterpretation: This is a source-specific decision made by the agent under the owner's delegation. It is not a claim that the owner spoke a source-specific approval, that a user-message time or identifier was supplied, or that deployment has happened. The record authorizes only the backend campaign; build-number allocation, artifact construction, installation, pilot promotion and a download channel are separate recorded decisions under the same delegation.

sourceAuthority.role: exact reviewed application baseline and backend execution commit; distinct from the feature-branch approval custody commit and a later artifact-version commit

deploymentExecutionAuthority.qualification: Commit the reviewed approval into immutable feature-branch custody without merging it into main. Deploy and collect evidence from an isolated clean main checkout at exactly c00c77e2, while freshly verified origin/main and remote main still equal that commit. The existing exact-main CI is evidence for this exact execution source. If remote main moves or the checkout differs, stop and make a new assessed source decision; do not relabel another commit or silently admit a descendant. Merge approval, verifier and measured reconciliation changes only after the backend readback.

approvedDeployment.callableProbeScope: Unauthenticated empty-request rejection probes only, including endpoints that require authentication before business mutation; normal access/error logs may be emitted. No authenticated business command or successful mutation is authorized by these probes.
